name: Keycloak
description: Identity and access management with OAuth2, OIDC, and SAML.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    command: start-dev
    environment:
      KC_DB: postgres
      KC_DB_URL_HOST: {{serviceName}}-db
      KC_DB_URL_DATABASE: keycloak
      KC_DB_USERNAME: keycloak
      KC_DB_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      KEYCLOAK_ADMIN: {{env.KEYCLOAK_ADMIN}}
      KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD: {{env.KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD}}
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-db
  {{serviceName}}-db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-db
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: keycloak
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: keycloak
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
